peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: perfringens normally forms a characteristic double zone of hemolysis (Fig. 3). The inner zone of complete hemolysis is caused by PFO; the outer zone of incomplete hemolysis is caused by CPA.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the medium for Clostridium perfringens?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: An improved selective medium, Tryptose-sulfite-cycloserine (TSC) agar, for the enumeration of Clostridium perfringens is described. It consists of the same basal medium as Shahidi-Ferguson-perfringens (SFP) agar, but with 400 μg of D-cycloserine per ml substituted for the kanamycin and polymyxin.
